summary: [standards] The unreachable-DSN plumbing (TierRegistry::with_unreachable, LoadedTiers.unreachable) is wired only through retention::loaded_registry. With a postgres hot tier and CANON_PG_DSN set to an unreachable host, query --kind session still answers QUERY_FAILED exit 1 with the message 'hot tier (postgres) is not attached (no live DSN)', which is false (the DSN is set), and tier age answers TIER_FAILED exit 1 'not attached (pool timed out ...)'. Both are reads that failed before any work, the class this change moved to _UNAVAILABLE for query's ledger EIO. Not asked for by the carried-over item (purge and export), so not blocking; say so in the CHANGELOG row of RETENTION_TIERS_UNAVAILABLE, or route query's tier build through the same registry (REPO_UNAVAILABLE) so the message stops saying 'no live DSN' for a DSN that is set.
